input.command:
cd /home/user/myproject
cat > builder.gd <<EOF
extends SceneTree

func _init():
	var root = Node3D.new()
	root.name = "Main"

	var world = Node3D.new()
	world.name = "World"
	root.add_child(world)
	world.owner = root

	var svp = SubViewport.new()
	svp.name = "SourceViewport"
	svp.size = Vector2i(256, 256)
	svp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS
	svp.transparent_bg = false
	world.add_child(svp)
	svp.owner = root

	var cam = Camera3D.new()
	cam.name = "SourceCamera"
	svp.add_child(cam)
	cam.owner = root
	cam.make_current()

	var sroot = Node3D.new()
	sroot.name = "SceneRoot"
	svp.add_child(sroot)
	sroot.owner = root

	var cubes = {
		"RedCube": Vector3(3, 0, 0),
		"GreenCube": Vector3(-3, 0, 0),
		"BlueCube": Vector3(0, 0, -3)
	}
	for name in cubes:
		var mi = MeshInstance3D.new()
		mi.name = name
		mi.mesh = BoxMesh.new()
		mi.mesh.size = Vector3(1, 1, 1)
		sroot.add_child(mi)
		mi.owner = root
		mi.global_position = cubes[name]

		var mat = StandardMaterial3D.new()
		mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
		mat.albedo_color = Color.RED if name=="RedCube" else (Color.GREEN if name=="GreenCube" else Color.BLUE)
		mi.material_override = mat

	var env = WorldEnvironment.new()
	var e = Environment.new()
	e.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
	e.background_color = Color.BLACK
	env.environment = e
	svp.add_child(env)
	env.owner = root

	var hud = CanvasLayer.new()
	hud.name = "HUD"
	root.add_child(hud)
	hud.owner = root

	var monitor = TextureRect.new()
	monitor.name = "MonitorScreen"
	monitor.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	monitor.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
	monitor.size = Vector2(256, 256)
	hud.add_child(monitor)
	monitor.owner = root
	var tex = ViewportTexture.new()
	tex.viewport_path = NodePath("World/SourceViewport")
	monitor.texture = tex

	var scn = PackedScene.new()
	scn.pack(root)
	ResourceSaver.save(scn, "res://main.tscn")
	print("done")
	quit()
EOF
godot -s builder.gd
